senses.gloss: f. (הדף, with ר inserted; cmp. הִירְדּוּף [removal, isolation,] imprisonment within a narrow enclosure of reeds or poles, a punishment for contempt of court (v. נִידּוּי).
units: Ib. (a version of the Gaonim quoted by Asheri a. l., Nr. 53) מאי ה׳ א״ר פפא נצבי דקני what is hardafah? Said R. P., Poles of reeds (fastened in the ground). [In ed. a. Mss. the answer to מאי ה׳ is absent.] [Ar. ed. Koh. הִרְדּוֹפָה.]
